title: PRD: NOVATEK Capture — designed preview
summary: Product requirements for the phone-first NOVATEK Capture preview: work-order-scoped identity, server-attributed captures and decisions, authored proposals, offline reconciliation, honesty labelling, and nine build phases.
scope: Identity and work-order access seam (gate, session, authorisation accessor)
Capture at the asset (camera, file-input path, spoken note, hash and thumbnail only)
Proposals and the decision step (accept/reject, decision context, server attribution)
Referrals (report something else, asset register resolution, flags, work proposal)
Offline queue and reconciliation (connectivity probe, conflicts, idempotency)
Installability and offline shell (service worker, storage persistence, WebKit cap, desktop frame)
Honesty surface (eight governed sentences, status ribbon, claims audit, build-check command, handover)
Cross-cutting NFRs (touch targets, WCAG 2.2, gloved usability)
Non-goals (no model, no redaction, no database, no supervisor role, no CMMS)
Nine build phases and ordering constraints
Success metrics SM-1 to SM-5 and counter-metrics SM-C1 to SM-C3
Three synthetic artisan personas (S. Mabaso, J. van Wyk, third persona)
